name: wame
description: Claude Code plugins by WAME — developer productivity tools for teams

plugins.name: git-commit
plugins.description: Turns your uncommitted changes into one or more logical git commits in the TYPE(scope): Message format, with the task ID in brackets when one is known. Never pushes, never amends.

plugins.name: git-commits-history
plugins.description: Summarizes the git commit history of all your repositories (GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket) for a date range: a timeline, AI summaries and a per-project breakdown. Renamed from git-commits in 2.0.0.

plugins.name: git-commits
plugins.description: [DEPRECATED] Renamed to git-commits-history. Run /plugin uninstall git-commits@wame && /plugin install git-commits-history@wame. Your config is kept.

plugins.name: laravel-docs
plugins.description: Generates technical, business and admin-navigation documentation for a Laravel model or module. Works with modular (wamesk/*, Modules/*) and flat (app/Models) projects.

plugins.name: work-rules
plugins.description: WAME rules for logging time and estimating work, independent of any task tracker: whole 5-minute time blocks, short tasks merged into one shared entry, no overlaps (wame-time-logging), and the wame-estimate-v3 methodology (wame-estimate). The Teamwork plugins and dnr-business depend on it.

plugins.name: dnr-business
plugins.description: Writes a WAME Detailný návrh riešenia (DNR), the binding pre-development project document, as a branded .docx in sk, cs or en. Input is a folder, files, a description or the current repository. Missing client data is marked [DOPLNIŤ], never invented.

plugins.name: teamwork-tasks-from-dnr
plugins.description: Turns a DNR document into a Teamwork.com import-ready task plan (XLSX + Markdown): tasklists and tasks with acceptance criteria, a goal, a technical plan and an estimate.

plugins.name: teamwork-task
plugins.description: Implements a Teamwork.com task or tasklist from its URL: reads the description, comments and attachments, plans and builds each task, commits it, moves the card on the board and logs the time back to Teamwork. You push.

plugins.name: teamwork-task-test
plugins.description: Checks a Teamwork.com task against the code: verifies each acceptance criterion with the existing tests, a real browser or a manual scenario, reviews UI/UX, performance, security and reachability, and reports the result per criterion. Always runs full, whatever the work mode.

plugins.name: teamwork-task-analyze
plugins.description: Prepares a Teamwork.com task for development: reads everything attached to it, scans the repository, asks the open questions and rewrites the description into the WAME format with acceptance criteria, a goal, a technical plan and an estimate. Each write needs your confirmation.

plugins.name: teamwork-tasks-from-desk
plugins.description: Turns a Teamwork Desk ticket into a Teamwork Projects task with subtasks, attachments and an estimate, links it to the ticket and leaves an internal note there. Never replies to the customer.

plugins.name: teamwork-tasks-from-session
plugins.description: Creates a Teamwork.com task from work you already did in a Claude Code session (its commits, diff and conversation) and logs the real session time to it. Each write needs your confirmation.

plugins.name: laravel-agents
plugins.description: Seven Laravel subagents (backend, database, API design, Pest tests, code review, security audit, performance) with the WAME coding standards as companion skills. For Nova, install laravel-nova-agents too.

plugins.name: laravel-nova-agents
plugins.description: The laravel-nova subagent for Laravel Nova admin panels: resources, fields, actions, lenses, filters, metrics, exports and Dusk tests, written for the installed Nova version. Ships wame-nova-ui, the UI/UX rules for Nova screens that design-agents loads. Install it with laravel-agents.

plugins.name: laravel-filament-agents
plugins.description: UI/UX rules for Laravel Filament panels (v3, v4, v5) in the wame-filament-ui skill: panel look, navigation, schemas, tables, actions and widgets. design-agents loads it for Filament projects. The Filament developer agent comes later.

plugins.name: ionic-agents
plugins.description: Modern Ionic mobile UI that does not look like the Ionic defaults, in the wame-ionic-ui skill: theming, navigation, sheets, lists, motion and accessibility. Detects Vue, React or Angular from the project. design-agents loads it for Ionic projects. The Ionic developer agent comes later.

plugins.name: work-mode
plugins.description: Build fast, check once. Fast mode builds without tests, reviews or browser checks, makes visual changes live in Chrome and waits until you approve them, and notes what it skipped; /work-mode full runs all the skipped checks at the end. Switch with /work-mode or set a default in /config.

plugins.name: design-agents
plugins.description: Wireframes, UI design and UX/accessibility review that do not look AI-generated: wireframer, ui-designer and ux-reviewer agents plus the wame-ui-ux skill (WCAG 2.2 AA, states, AI-look audit). Loads the Nova, Filament and Ionic UI skills when installed. Installs frontend-design and chrome-devtools-mcp with it.
